issue.title: Make the sase.dev_update package init lazy (PEP 562)
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1tz.3.1.4 (swap_launch_guards, epic sase-1tz.3.1) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3; filed by the sase-1tz.3.1 land agent.

Importing any `sase.dev_update.*` module runs the package `__init__`, which costs about 500 ms and about 900 modules. Because of that cost, swap_launch_guards had to mirror the code-swap lock and stamp filenames and the 120 s grace into the light `src/sase/core/code_swap_epoch.py`, pinned by a parity test in `tests/core/test_code_swap_epoch.py`. It also forced `src/sase/axe/chop_swap_guard.py` into use-site imports of `sase.dev_update.code_swap_lock` and `code_swap_stamp`.

Proposal: make `src/sase/dev_update/__init__.py` lazy with PEP 562 `__getattr__`, the way `sase.axe` does through `sase._lazy_exports`. Then let `code_swap_epoch` read through `code_swap_stamp` and `code_swap_lock` directly and delete the mirrored constants and their parity test. Keep the TUI first-paint import budget intact; check the existing import-budget tests.
